title: Generate sub-stories from planning loop with user approval
userStory: As a developer, I want to review generated sub-stories before they're created so that I control the breakdown.
acceptanceCriteria: Planning loop output parsed for user stories (US-001, US-002, etc. format)
Planning output shown as preview, NOT auto-saved as children
User can edit story titles, acceptance criteria inline
User can delete stories they don't want
User can reorder stories and adjust dependencies
'Approve & Create Stories' button commits the breakdown
'Request Revision' sends feedback for another planning iteration
Parent task updated with childIds[] only after user approval
